notes: Moved: NYD 2026 at Coburg Velodrome, NYD 2027 at The Nursery, Flemington (dedicated cocktail area, bigger production). Werribee era ended after NYD 2025 (Wyndham TV reports a $9,880 noise fine, date not established). The id let-them-eat-cake-werribee is now misleading. Collabs with Revolver, Brown Alley and Simma are side-event venue partners, not sponsors. Creative direction by Studio Hi Ho and Peter Deering, the same credit as A3's site.
